question: Early 2020 studies tied blood group A to severe COVID-19 and group O to protection. What did a study of 107,796 people find?
options: No link to infection or severity
The same link, about as strong
Group O at the higher risk
answer: No link to infection or severity. Anderson and colleagues followed everyone tested in a Utah health system: blood group made no difference to testing positive, hospital admission or intensive care. Early, smaller studies are the likeliest to report striking effects, which shrink as numbers grow; genetic studies still find at most a small effect.
move: Expect a striking first result to shrink when a bigger study checks it.
ask: Which striking first result have I repeated lately that a larger study may have shrunk?
trap: Expecting an effect reported by several early studies to hold at full strength.
source: Anderson et al., JAMA Network Open, 2021
